messages:
maria: Quick sync — packaging pricing change: we need clear owners for three implementation pieces before next Friday milestone: metering adapter, billing schema migration, and quota mapping/contract constraint checks. Who can own what?
jon: I can take metering adapter. need to know if reserved capacity tags are required (they are for Dedicated) and whether we should do tag-based or prefix-based metering.
alex: I’ll own billing schema migration. will prep a compatibility layer for both v1/v2 schemas. linking draft PR in a bit.
sarah: I can pick quota mapping + contract constraint logic, but need a concrete list of constraint types. are we enforcing min_commit + usage_floor + overage_caps, or is it simpler?
jon: agree on tags — current telemetry only emits model+route. adding reserved_capacity:true tag will be a small producer change, but adapter has to aggregate by tag. plan: adapter will accept a `group_by` config (model, route, tag).
maria: good. Sarah — for contract constraints, product listed three: min_commit, floor_threshold, and soft_cap_overage. but legal flagged a special clause in enterprise contracts (usage_floor_exemption). we need vetting from contracts. pinging @contracts-team. :eyes:
contracts-bot: Automated note: Contract 2024-ENT-042 includes clause usage_floor_exemption. See https://contracts.redwood/2024-ENT-042 — teams must implement opt-out logic if clause present.
sarah: ok that clarifies. so mapping needs to produce final quota = if usage_floor_exemption then contract.quota_override else standard_quota. will add this to the mapping table.
alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4521 — migration layer is WIP. sample migration snippet:```json
{
  "billing_version": "v2",
  "mappings": [{"old_rate_id":"r-123","new_sku":"pricing_optimized_v2"}]
}
```
alex: Heads-up: I’ll include a toggle (feature flag) for gradual rollout, and a fallback to v1 if any downstream billing failures.
jon: for testing, I’ll add an adapter integration test that replays prefix+taged telemetry and asserts tokens and billing units. ETA: Tues for unit tests + Wed for integration smoke.
tim: from infra — make sure quota mapping runs in idempotent mode. if mapping job runs twice for same contract it should be a no-op. also prefer a dry-run mode before final write.
maria: action items: jon -> metering adapter (tag support + group_by config) — deliver tests by Tue/Wed; alex -> billing migration PR + feature flag, include fallback; sarah -> quota mapping + contract exception handling (usage_floor_exemption); tim -> infra dry-run + idempotency checks; contracts-bot helped clarify clause.
maria: Can everyone add their owner tag to the project board and drop a short note in the PR with expected rollback plan? :thumbsup:
alex: done — added owner tag and rollback steps in PR.
jon: added test checklist to board.
sarah: added mapping table and contract edge cases doc in the ticket.
maria: thanks. follow-up async sync on Thursday EOD to verify blockers. if anything high-risk pops up ping #incidents or @maria directly.
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging deploy window Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Any migration that touches billing DB must opt into migration window and set `allow_write=false` until after the window.
jon: noted — will schedule adapter deploy to avoid write window.
maria: perfect — closing thread for now, will reopen if blockers.
